title: Two Mothers and One Baby
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks closely until the truth shows itself, and tonight Solomon finds the real mother by watching what love does: Scout settles a crayon quarrel by looking carefully and asking Heavenly Father to help her be fair.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout looks closely until the truth shows itself, and Solomon found the truth by watching what each mother’s heart did. In Scout’s world today: two crayons are on the floor and both little brothers shout, “That one is mine!” Scout does not grab or guess. She looks closely, sees the name written on the paper, and asks Heavenly Father in her heart to help her be fair. Just like Solomon, Scout learned that wisdom is a gift we can ask for.
